summary: Product Link: https://hro.net/RjlwOXNBZEF The IC-PW2 uses new 65 V LDMOS power transistors (MRFX1K80HR5) and a high-efficiency power supply. Achieve a 1kW output with a 200V AC Input. The IC- PW2 instantly operates at full power once turned on. Use the PW2 for long contest hours or full-duty FT8 operation.
